title: Markers
style: grainy found-footage still from a handheld camcorder and headlamps, deep uncharted limestone cave, harsh white headlamp beams cutting total darkness, wet glistening rock, VHS noise and lens flare, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. Someone in Cave 3 is drawing chalk arrows. In Lou's handwriting. ➡️

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: three friends filmed their way into an uncharted cave, and a fourth headlamp watched them from the dark.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a single distant headlamp glowing in a black cave

scenes.narration: Tape two. They argue about turning back. Priya wins. If someone's down here, she says, they might need help.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of a determined woman in a caving helmet facing two companions in a narrow tunnel

scenes.narration: They mark the way with chalk. A white arrow at every turn, pointing back to the exit. Standard practice.
scenes.image: grainy close-up still of a gloved hand drawing a white chalk arrow on wet dark cave rock

scenes.narration: Forty minutes in, Lou stops. There's already an arrow on the wall. White chalk. Fresh enough to smudge.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of a fresh white chalk arrow on a cave wall, a fingertip smearing its edge

scenes.narration: It isn't pointing out. It's pointing deeper.
scenes.image: grainy still of a chalk arrow on rock pointing down into a narrow descending black passage

scenes.narration: Dev says another team. Priya says there is no other team. Nobody knows this cave exists.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of two cavers arguing in a cramped tunnel, headlamps glaring into the lens

scenes.narration: Every turn, another arrow waits. Always fresh. Always deeper. With a little hook on the arrowhead. Lou stares at it. That's how I draw them, he says. Nobody else does that.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of a pale man staring at a hooked chalk arrow on a cave wall, his own chalk in his hand

scenes.narration: They decide to follow their own arrows home. They turn around. Every arrow they drew is gone. Wiped clean.
scenes.image: grainy still of a bare wet cave wall with a faint smeared white smudge where a chalk mark used to be

scenes.narration: The only chalk left on the walls points one way. Down.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of a row of white chalk arrows on tunnel walls all pointing down into darkness

scenes.narration: And from somewhere ahead, very softly, they hear it. The scrape of chalk on stone. Someone drawing the next one.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a black tunnel bend, the faint edge of a headlamp glow around the corner
